title: Unit contraction of the normalized reindexing tensor square
statement: Fix l,D,C,T,U,g as in lem-sf-adic-reindexing-unit-compatibility and assume the specialized tensor square at the two coefficient units. Then the unit square displayed in normalized_reindexing_unit_compatibility holds for the chosen canonical unit witness.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15, unit calculation after tensor compatibility.

proof.text: Prove the ordinary reindexing left-unitor equation for its recorded tensor and coefficient-unit maps, from their pure-section formulas and representative normalization.

Put q=J_X(epsilon_P) followed by epsilon_X inverse and z=alpha inverse at I followed by q. Precompose the tensor square at (I,I) with the image of tensoring epsilon_Y with an identity, and postcompose it with the image of tensoring epsilon_P with an identity, the common-stage left unitor, and q. The source and target realization left-unit laws, the selected canonical unit witness equation, tensorator naturality and comparison naturality identify the resulting equality with G(leftUnitor) followed by z = V.tensor followed by tensor(G(epsilon_Y) followed by z,id), the ambient left unitor, and z.

Use ordinary reindexing left unitality, cancel z, the invertible tensorator and the ambient left unitor. This equates tensoring G(epsilon_Y) followed by z with an identity to tensoring pullUnit with that identity. Tensoring by the other factor is faithful because z identifies that factor with the tensor unit; transport to tensoring by the unit and cancel the right unitor. Finally postcompose with epsilon_X and cancel its inverse to obtain exactly the given unit square.

lean.statement:
theorem reindexing_tensor_unit_contraction
    (C : FamilyCore l D) (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
    (h_tensor : unitTensorSquare l D C T U g) :
    letI := (C.data T).units
    letI := (C.data U).units
    (derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map (C.data U).tensor.unit.hom ≫
      (C.comparison T U g).inv.app (pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left) ≫
      (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
        (C.unit_spec T U g).exists.choose.hom =
    (pullUnit l T.base.left g.hom (C.pullTensor T U g)).hom ≫
      (C.data T).tensor.unit.hom
